page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m8.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon processors running at 2.7 GHz. This KVM-virtualized instance features 12 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a resource-density perspective, the high memory allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU allows for efficient resource utilization in memory-intensive workloads without requiring the acquisition of unnecessary compute cores.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for memory-optimized workloads. Appropriate use cases include in-memory databases, caching layers, data buffering, and enterprise applications that require substantial memory capacity relative to processing power.
